title: Gradient Descent: Walking Down x Squared

input.request: explain gradient descent with one worked example

description:
The learner will understand how gradient descent repeatedly steps against the slope to reach a minimum, by following three steps on f(x) = x squared.
Scene 1 (12 s): Gradient descent finds the lowest point of a curve by repeatedly stepping downhill.
Scene 2 (16 s): Each step moves x against the slope, scaled by a learning rate.
Scene 3 (18 s): Repeating the rule moves x closer to the minimum each time.
Scene 4 (14 s): The learning rate controls step size: too small is slow, too big overshoots.
Narrated by one voice; 4 scenes; 60 seconds.
